title: Go loop refuses to double-start
notes: history.jsonl shows two loop_started events 42 seconds apart on 2026-08-22 (pids 56941 and 59762), so two loops can run at once and race on task claims. Make go-loop.sh check status.json on startup: if it records a pid that is still alive, exit with a clear message instead of starting a second loop. A stale pid (process gone) is fine to take over. Acceptance: starting the loop twice leaves exactly one running loop and the second invocation explains why it declined.
